title: Payment Record Courtesy on Reference-Testing Cancellation Fees
content:
A patient's payment record with Patient Invoices & Statements earns a courtesy that is subtracted from the reference-testing cancellation handling fee on a Laboratory Test Orders accession of the Esoteric Reference Testing class.

**Clause.** When the patient's invoice activity shows at least two payments received in the 24 months before today and no payment reversed in those 24 months, **5.00** is subtracted from the handling fee. When it shows exactly one payment received and no payment reversed in those 24 months, **2.00** is subtracted from the handling fee. Any other payment record, including one with a reversed payment, has no courtesy subtracted.

| Payments received, last 24 months | Payments reversed, last 24 months | Subtracted from the handling fee |
|---|---|---|
| Two or more | None | 5.00 |
| Exactly one | None | 2.00 |
| Any | One or more | nothing |
| None | None | nothing |

**Cases (hypothetical).** Four payments over the last two years and no reversal: 5.00. One payment 20 months ago: 2.00. Three payments, one of which was reversed: nothing. A payment received 26 months ago and nothing since: outside the 24 months, so nothing.
